verses.en: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
verses.pt: Provérbios de Salomão, filho de Davi, rei de Israel.
verses.en_web: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:
verses.en_bbe: The wise sayings of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel.

verses.en: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;
verses.pt: Para conhecer a sabedoria e a instrução; para entender as palavras da prudência;
verses.en_web: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;
verses.en_bbe: To have knowledge of wise teaching; to be clear about the words of reason:

verses.en: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;
verses.pt: Para obter a instrução do entendimento; justiça, juízo e equidades;
verses.en_web: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;
verses.en_bbe: To be trained in the ways of wisdom, in righteousness and judging truly and straight behaviour:

verses.en: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.
verses.pt: Para dar inteligência aos simples, conhecimento e bom senso aos jovens.
verses.en_web: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man:
verses.en_bbe: To make the simple-minded sharp, and to give the young man knowledge, and serious purpose:

verses.en: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
verses.pt: O sábio ouvirá, e crescerá em conhecimento; o bom entendedor obterá sábios conselhos.
verses.en_web: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
verses.en_bbe: (The wise man, hearing, will get greater learning, and the acts of the man of good sense will be wisely guided:)

verses.en: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
verses.pt: Para entender provérbios e sua interpretação; as palavras dos sábios, e seus enigmas.
verses.en_web: to understand a proverb, and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.
verses.en_bbe: To get the sense of wise sayings and secrets, and of the words of the wise and their dark sayings.

verses.en: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.pt: O temor ao SENHOR é o principio do conhecimento; os tolos desprezam a sabedoria e a instrução.
verses.en_web: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.en_bbe: The fear of the Lord is the start of knowledge: but the foolish have no use for wisdom and teaching.

verses.en: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.pt: Filho meu, ouve a instrução de teu pai; e não abandones a doutrina de tua mãe.
verses.en_web: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:
verses.en_bbe: My son, give ear to the training of your father, and do not give up the teaching of your mother:

verses.en: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.
verses.pt: Porque serão um ornamento gracioso para tua cabeça; e colares para teu pescoço.
verses.en_web: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
verses.en_bbe: For they will be a crown of grace for your head, and chain-ornaments about your neck.

verses.en: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
verses.pt: Filho meu, se os pecadores tentarem te convencer, não te deixes influenciar.
verses.en_web: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.
verses.en_bbe: My son, if sinners would take you out of the right way, do not go with them.

verses.en: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:
verses.pt: Se disserem: Vem conosco, vamos espiar derramamento de sangue; preparemos uma emboscada ao inocente sem razão.
verses.en_web: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lay in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.
verses.en_bbe: If they say, Come with us; let us make designs against the good, waiting secretly for the upright, without cause;

verses.en: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:
verses.pt: Vamos tragá-los vivos, como o Xeol; e inteiros, como os que descem à cova.
verses.en_web: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.
verses.en_bbe: Let us overcome them living, like the underworld, and in their strength, as those who go down to death;

verses.en: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:
verses.pt: Acharemos toda espécie de coisas valiosas, encheremos nossas casas de despojos.
verses.en_web: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.
verses.en_bbe: Goods of great price will be ours, our houses will be full of wealth;

verses.en: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:
verses.pt: Lança tua sorte entre nós, compartilharemos todos de uma só bolsa.
verses.en_web: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse.”
verses.en_bbe: Take your chance with us, and we will all have one money-bag:

verses.en: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:
verses.pt: Filho meu, não sigas teu caminho com eles; desvia teu pé para longe de onde eles passarem;
verses.en_web: My son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
verses.en_bbe: My son, do not go with them; keep your feet from their ways:

verses.en: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.
verses.pt: Porque os pés deles correm para o mal, e se apressam para derramar sangue.
verses.en_web: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.
verses.en_bbe: For their feet are running after evil, and they are quick to take a man's life.

verses.en: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.
verses.pt: Certamente é inútil se estender a rede diante da vista de todas as aves;
verses.en_web: For in vain is the net spread in the sight of any bird:
verses.en_bbe: Truly, to no purpose is the net stretched out before the eyes of the bird:

verses.en: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.
verses.pt: Porém estes estão esperando o derramamento de seu próprio sangue; e preparam emboscada para suas próprias almas.
verses.en_web: but these lay wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.
verses.en_bbe: And they are secretly waiting for their blood and making ready destruction for themselves.

verses.en: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
verses.pt: Assim são os caminhos de todo aquele que tem ganância pelo lucro desonesto; ela tomará a alma daqueles que a tem.
verses.en_web: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.
verses.en_bbe: Such is the fate of everyone who goes in search of profit; it takes away the life of its owners.

verses.en: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:
verses.pt: A sabedoria grita pelas ruas; nas praças ela levanta sua voz.
verses.en_web: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.
verses.en_bbe: Wisdom is crying out in the street; her voice is loud in the open places;

verses.en: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,
verses.pt: Ela clama nas encruzilhadas, onde passam muita gente; às entradas das portas, nas cidades ela diz suas mensagens:
verses.en_web: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:
verses.en_bbe: Her words are sounding in the meeting-places, and in the doorways of the town:

verses.en: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?
verses.pt: Até quando, ó tolos, amareis a tolice? E vós zombadores, desejareis a zombaria? E vós loucos, odiareis o conhecimento?
verses.en_web: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?
verses.en_bbe: How long, you simple ones, will foolish things be dear to you? and pride a delight to the haters of authority? how long will the foolish go on hating knowledge?

verses.en: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
verses.pt: Convertei-vos à minha repreensão; eis que vos derramarei meu espírito, e vos farei saber minhas palavras.
verses.en_web: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
verses.en_bbe: Be turned again by my sharp words: see, I will send the flow of my spirit on you, and make my words clear to you.

verses.en: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;
verses.pt: Mas porque eu clamei, e recusastes; estendi minha mão, e não houve quem desse atenção,
verses.en_web: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;
verses.en_bbe: Because your ears were shut to my voice; no one gave attention to my out-stretched hand;

verses.en: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:
verses.pt: E rejeitastes todo o meu conselho, e não quisestes minha repreensão,
verses.en_web: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;
verses.en_bbe: You were not controlled by my guiding, and would have nothing to do with my sharp words:

verses.en: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
verses.pt: Também eu rirei em vosso sofrimento, e zombarei, quando vier vosso medo.
verses.en_web: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you;
verses.en_bbe: So in the day of your trouble I will be laughing; I will make sport of your fear;

verses.en: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.
verses.pt: Quando vier vosso temor como tempestade, e a causa de vosso sofrimento como ventania, quando vier sobre vós a opressão e a angústia,
verses.en_web: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind; when distress and anguish come on you.
verses.en_bbe: When your fear comes on you like a storm, and your trouble like a rushing wind; when pain and sorrow come on you.

verses.en: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:
verses.pt: Então clamarão a mim; porém eu não responderei; de madrugada me buscarão, porém não me acharão.
verses.en_web: Then will they call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me;
verses.en_bbe: Then I will give no answer to their cries; searching for me early, they will not see me:

verses.en: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the LORD:
verses.pt: Porque odiaram o conhecimento; e escolheram não temer ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: For they were haters of knowledge, and did not give their hearts to the fear of the Lord:

verses.en: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
verses.pt: Não concordaram com meu conselho, e desprezaram toda a minha repreensão.
verses.en_web: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
verses.en_bbe: They had no desire for my teaching, and my words of protest were as nothing to them.

verses.en: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
verses.pt: Por isso comerão do fruto do seu próprio caminho, e se fartarão de seus próprios conselhos.
verses.en_web: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
verses.en_bbe: So the fruit of their way will be their food, and with the designs of their hearts they will be made full.

verses.en: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.
verses.pt: Pois o desvio dos tolos os matará, e a confiança dos loucos os destruirá.
verses.en_web: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.
verses.en_bbe: For the turning back of the simple from teaching will be the cause of their death, and the peace of the foolish will be their destruction.

verses.en: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
verses.pt: Porém aquele que me ouvir habitará em segurança, e estará tranquilo do temor do mal.
verses.en_web: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
verses.en_bbe: But whoever gives ear to me will take his rest safely, living in peace without fear of evil.
